The currency test depends on internet access.

terms.meaning: a Python tool that finds and runs test functions and reports failures
a check in a test that must be true for the test to pass

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test imports
sections.what: Loads the testing library and the helper functions the tests check.
sections.why: The tests need the functions they examine.
sections.watch_out: A broken import in the helpers module makes every test in this file fail to start.

sections.name: TestTextProcessing
sections.title: Tests for cleaning and comparing text
sections.what: Checks that cleaning removes punctuation and extra spaces, that identical texts score 1, that unrelated texts score below 0.5, and that similar texts score above 0.7.
sections.why: Protects the duplicate headline detection that depends on these functions.
sections.watch_out: The similarity thresholds are fixed numbers, so a change to the scoring method can break these tests without a bug in the code.

sections.name: TestNumberExtraction
sections.title: Tests for pulling figures from text
sections.what: Checks that money in millions and billions, MW, and km are extracted, and that several figures in one sentence are all found.
sections.why: Confirms the patterns find the figures they are meant to find.
sections.watch_out: Only a few formats are tested, so other currency and unit spellings are not covered.

sections.name: TestCurrencyConversion
sections.title: Tests for currency conversion
sections.what: Checks that US dollars convert to themselves unchanged and that an unknown currency returns no answer.
sections.why: Confirms the two basic outcomes of conversion.
sections.watch_out: The unknown currency test may make a live internet request, so its speed and path depend on network access.

sections.name: entry point
sections.title: Running tests directly
sections.what: Runs this test file with verbose output when it is started directly.
sections.why: Gives a quick way to run the checks without a separate command.

summary: Automated checks for the helper functions, covering text comparison, number extraction, and currency conversion.
purpose: Catches breakage in helper behaviour before it reaches the pipeline.
why: Likely reason: the helpers feed duplicate detection and money figures, so errors there would spread quietly.
how: 1) Import the helper functions. 2) Run the text tests. 3) Run the number extraction tests. 4) Run the currency tests. Run the file with pytest.
inputs: Fixed sample sentences and numbers written in the file.
outputs: A pass or fail result for each test, shown by pytest.
risks: The tests were not run during this review, so whether they pass is unknown. The currency test may use the network. Coverage is narrow, with nothing for caching, the logger, or the news fetcher.
debug: Run pytest on this file with verbose output. A failing check prints the expected and actual values. For currency tests, confirm internet access and look at the cache file. For an import error, confirm the helpers module loads on its own.
